notes: Non-aligned is a curated set of 40 major airline brands outside the three global alliances, not a claim to enumerate every independent airline worldwide.
Alaska Airlines remains in oneworld and is not duplicated under Non-aligned.
For point-to-point airlines, explicitly identified major operating bases or focus cities are retained as their actual role rather than mislabeled as hubs.
LATAM, easyJet, Ryanair, and Wizz Air are represented as explicitly enumerated operating-brand groups where relevant; individual source service brands remain visible.

Selection is source-defined: Ryanair primary bases, Wizz Air largest bases, easyJet largest base, Vueling main/secondary bases; for carriers without such narrowing labels, all current infobox operating bases are included.
Condor Münster/Osnabrück base begins 2 November 2026, after snapshot, so is excluded as a current origin.
Alexandria is normalized to current IATA ALY (formerly HBE), effective 16 September 2026, using an explicit Aegean code-change bulletin; original Borg El Arab coordinates retained.
